chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the inheritance share of the grandfather (paternal), so he said: 'I do not know anyone who gave a ruling in it except by personal opinion, except Ali (peace be upon him), for he ruled with the saying of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).'

key_terms.بِقَوْلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: With the saying/ruling of the Messenger of Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of the grandfather according to the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the jurisprudential debate regarding the grandfather's share in inheritance, contrasting the prevalent reliance on personal reasoning (*ra'y*) with the unique position of Imam Ali (AS). The Imam asserts that Ali (AS) alone adhered to the direct Sunnah of the Prophet (SAWW), establishing a precedent for prioritizing prophetic tradition over analogical deduction in this specific legal matter. This underscores the Shia emphasis on the Ahl al-Bayt's exclusive access to the true interpretation of divine law.
